vesktop-themes.name: Ryoku Discord Optimized
vesktop-themes.author: Ron (original), Sipper1236 (performance adaptation)
vesktop-themes.summary: Ryoku paper-and-ink theme with lighter list animations
vesktop-themes.description: A performance-focused adaptation of Ron’s Ryoku Discord v3 theme. List hover movement uses translate; friends and requests use one fade per surface instead of per-row staggered entrances. Enable Ryoku Optimized in Vesktop Settings → Vencord → Themes after installation.
